# Hunza Longevity Resort

> Hunza Longevity is a boutique, physician-guided wellness and longevity retreat in Maşukiye, Kartepe (Kocaeli, Turkey), in the forested hills near Lake Sapanca and about one hour by private transfer from Istanbul's Sabiha Gökçen Airport. The property has twelve private 60 m² villas and offers personalised 3-, 7- and 14-day programmes combining medical assessment, nutrition, movement, restorative therapies, spa and sleep — organised around a six-pillar methodology (Medivo, Calmio, Movio, Nutrivo, Bello, Dormio).

## Location & contact
- Location: Maşukiye, Kartepe, Kocaeli, Turkey (near Lake Sapanca)
- Nearest airport: Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen (SAW), ~65 km / ~1 hour by private transfer
- From central Istanbul: ~130 km / ~1 hour 45 minutes
- Website: https://hunzalongevity.com/
- Phone: +90 532 733 3541

## Notes
- Programmes are personalised from an initial assessment; content is adapted to the individual rather than a fixed schedule.
- Hunza is a wellness retreat, not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment. Any condition requiring diagnosis or treatment should be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional.
